decision_note: Prague VC (two funds, EUR 40m invested since 2016) that launched the EUR 150m defence/dual-use fund Presto Tech Horizons with CSG in 2024; led DiffuseDrive's seed (May 2025) and Occam's pre-seed (Feb 2026) and joined Firehawk's Series C (Sep 2025).

evidence.quote: Mostly post-revenue companies raising a €800k to €8M financing round, looking to accelerate their growth.
Our new €150M fund targets the best of security, defense, and aerospace tech, with focus on dual-use.
Disponuje celkem 150 miliony eur, v přepočtu 3,7 miliardy korun.
V členských zemích NATO a u spojenců plánuje podpořit desítky projektů, jejichž řešení mají víceúčelové, takzvané dual-use využití v civilním i bezpečnostním sektoru.
Klíčový milník jde ruku v ruce s uzavřením úvodního, tzv. pre-seedového investičního kola ve výši tři miliony eur (přes 72 milionů korun), které vedl fond český Presto Tech Horizons
Do Firehawku se navíc zapojil i fond Presto Tech Horizons, který založila VC firma Presto Ventures a průmyslově-technologická skupina CSG Michala Strnada.
fond Presto Tech Horizons společně s americkým Outlanderem vedly seed investici ve výši 3,5 milionu dolarů, v přepočtu 78 milionů korun
Since 2016, we’ve invested €40M from two funds.

analyst_notes: Presto Tech Horizons is the third Presto vehicle, set up with Michal Strnad's CSG as industrial partner and one of many LPs; EUR 150m per CzechCrunch 2024-06-26 (launch) and the Presto site (undated). Earlier: EUR 40m invested from two funds since 2016 (site, e9). Stage from the site block 'Seed TO SERIES A' plus e1 (rounds of EUR 800k-8M); tickets EUR 500k-5M (e2). Sector: security, defence and aerospace with dual-use focus (mapped to defence_dualuse + deeptech_hardware). Geography: NATO member states and allies (CzechCrunch 2024). Investments are made by Presto Tech Horizons; Firehawk round is the whole USD 60m Series C led by 1789 Capital; Occam EUR 3m pre-seed led by Presto Tech Horizons (company country not stated in the article - drones deployed on the Ukrainian front). Governance: founder Přemysl Rubeš was detained by police in March 2026 for reasons unrelated to the business per partner Vojta Roček (CzechCrunch 2026-03-11), and had not been involved in the CSG cooperation for several months; Presto says it continues investing. A CzechCrunch article of 2026-10-07 refers to 'Tech Horizons ze skupiny CSG', which may indicate a rebranding/separation; ARES lists Tech Horizons a.s. (IČO 22399127, 2024-12-21) and Tech Horizons Partners s.r.o. (IČO 23659441), but their link to the fund was not verified, so they are not listed as legal entities.
